awards_draft#u3.rationale: Verified via 2026 reporting: eligibility = 65 games (20+ min in 63, 15-20 min allowed in two more), covering MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA and All-Defense; ROY, Sixth Man and All-Rookie exempt (secondary source). Also verified: an 'extraordinary circumstances' appeal to an NBA/NBPA-designated expert can grant eligibility (Doncic and Cunningham granted, Edwards denied, 2025-26). The record has no appeal stage, so eligibility is not a pure ledger gate.
awards_draft#u3.catalog_action: Add an appeal stage (filing and grant probability) to nba.games_played_eligibility / nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger in awards_draft, and record the verified list of governed awards (MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA, All-Defense) with exemptions.

awards_draft#u5.rationale: Verified for 2026: starters 50% fans / 25% players / 25% media; coaches pick 7 reserves per conference regardless of position (positionless); the USA-vs-World format needs 16 US and 8 international All-Stars, with the Commissioner adding players to fill the quotas. The record's position-group split is wrong, and the nationality quota plus Commissioner additions are a selection stage it lacks.
awards_draft#u5.catalog_action: In awards_draft, rewrite nba.allstar_reserve_coach_vote to positionless selection and add a nationality-quota/Commissioner-addition stage with a player nationality input. Mark the 2027 format as pending until the league announces it.

awards_draft#u6.rationale: The Hustle Award is chosen by formula from tracked hustle stats (deflections, charges drawn, loose balls, screen assists, contests). No catalog input aggregates those stats, so the KXNBAHUSTLE mechanism has no driver. This is a missing input, not a magnitude.
awards_draft#u6.catalog_action: Author an nba.hustle_stat_index input (league hustle-stats endpoint, award formula weights) and attach it to KXNBAHUSTLE in awards_draft. Keep Teammate and Sportsmanship on the generic nominee model.

awards_draft#u8.rationale: Verified: 2026 Hall of Fame finalists were named in February (All-Star weekend) and the class was announced April 4, 2026 at the Final Four. The 18-of-24 Honors Committee threshold could not be confirmed (hoophall.com not reachable; tallies are secret). The threshold is a constant inside the existing election model and does not change its inputs.

combo_props#u3.rationale: The minutes-regime split (blowout, foul trouble, OT, restriction) is already defined in the record. The cutoffs (margin 18, 4 fouls by Q3) are thresholds that minutes and play-by-play histograms settle.

combo_props#u4.rationale: Lineup-conditional rates and season-average fallbacks are both defined. How fast new rosters graduate from the fallback is a shrinkage constant and sample-size question settled by backtests on past trades.

combo_props#u6.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.load_mgmt already exist in the NBA catalog (attached to game_total, combo_props, player_availability, season_futures_team); both are attached to combo_props. What is open is how large rest and restriction effects are on the minutes-mixture weights, which a calibration on availability history settles.

first_basket#u3.rationale: The tip-win input and jumper-skill term are defined. The 0.1 slope is a coefficient to fit by logit on jump-ball events from free play-by-play.

game_moneyline_spread#u3.rationale: nba.referee_crew is attached to the record. Whether a crew effect on margin exists, and how big it is, is a significance and effect-size test on margin residuals.

game_moneyline_spread#u4.rationale: Coach rotation behaviour is named (nba.rotation in the catalog, nba.load_mgmt attached here). Fitting coach-level rotation priors from five seasons of minutes, and accepting the residual noise, is calibration.

game_moneyline_spread#u5.rationale: nba.series_game_conditional_state is defined and attached. series_and_cup holds the series-level tickers and the same conditional-state input, so ownership is settled. What is open is the size of the elimination and adjustment effects.

game_moneyline_spread#u6.rationale: Home-court value, margin sd and the overtime rate are parameters of inputs that already exist. Re-estimating them from team-game logs is pure data analysis.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u2.rationale: The tie-mass excess factor kappa is a parameter of nba.reg_tie_pmf_model. It can be estimated from 15 seasons of line scores with a stability check across rule changes.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u5.rationale: nba.bench_minutes_distribution and nba.rotation are attached, and nba.rest_travel is in the catalog. Whether rest or playoff status shifts bench share beyond blowout effects is a regression to run.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u6.rationale: Per-game OT probability (nba.reg_tie_pmf_model) and series conditioning are defined. The within-series dispersion of OT-game counts is a correlation parameter to estimate from playoff series. Incomplete-series settlement is a Kalshi wording issue, not missing catalog information.

game_overtime_and_team_events#u7.rationale: P(2OT|OT), OT points and bench-points mean/sd are recalled parameters of existing inputs. Line scores and box scores give them directly.

game_total#u2.rationale: Pace composition is part of the existing pace input. Whether it is slower-team-controls or additive, and how it varies by era, is a regression on possession data.

game_total#u7.rationale: The crew effect (nba.referee_crew), total sd, cross term and OT block are all magnitudes of attached inputs. Game logs settle them.

game_win_margin#u2.rationale: The OT and parity corrections to the margin pmf are already in the mechanism. Their size and structural breaks are estimable from 10 seasons of results.

game_win_margin#u4.rationale: nba.rotation is attached and standings and rest are catalog inputs. Pull timing as a function of stakes is a per-coach estimate, not a missing definition.

off_court_events#u3.rationale: Verified: the March 2026 vote to explore Las Vegas/Seattle expansion needed 23 of 30 governors (three-quarters). Relocation thresholds conflict across secondary sources, but the approval-vote input is unchanged either way. Process-to-award durations are a tabulation of past decisions.

off_court_events#u4.rationale: Expansion awards, conference realignment (two new Western cities force teams East) and a European-league announcement are causally linked board decisions. The record prices KXNBACITYEXPAND, KXNBAJOINCONF and KXNBAEUROPEANNOUNCE as independent events. A joint dependence structure is missing, not just unmeasured.
off_court_events#u4.catalog_action: Author a joint governance scenario input (expansion award -> realignment -> European announcement, keyed to board calendars) in off_court_events. Wire the three series to it in place of independent hazards.

off_court_events#u5.rationale: Per-type inputs exist for most families and nba.offfield_base_rate covers the rest. Choosing window lengths for player-trade, relocation and retirement reference classes is a sensitivity and calibration choice made on historical counts.

off_court_events#u6.rationale: Report-to-event conversions, retirement hazards and stage completion rates are magnitudes of existing hazard inputs, settled by compiling 10 years of deal and retirement outcomes. The expansion threshold is verified as 3/4 (23 of 30).

off_court_events#u7.rationale: The 2023 CBA (through 2029-30) sets max tiers at 25/30/35% of the cap by service (0-6, 7-9, 10+ years) with designated-veteran criteria. These are inputs nba.next_contract_value_model already uses. The open item is the league's periodic cap projection, a published figure not retrieved here.

parlay_combo#u3.rationale: The copula is an existing input. Gaussian vs t or mixture is a model-selection question settled by held-out log-likelihood on joint box-score outcomes.

parlay_combo#u4.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.game_factor_loadings are attached to parlay_combo. Whether rest loads on the common minutes factor is a loading test.

parlay_combo#u6.rationale: Same-game and cross-game dependence figures are parameters of nba.game_factor_loadings. They are estimable from 10 seasons of box scores.

parlay_combo#u7.rationale: KXNBANHL needs a Stanley Cup probability, and no NBA input defines or references one. The cross-sport link (input id, as-of alignment) is missing from the record.
parlay_combo#u7.catalog_action: Link the NHL catalog's Stanley Cup title input by id with as-of timestamp alignment (or define a shared cross-sport input) and attach it to KXNBANHL in parlay_combo.

player_assists#u3.rationale: The zero-minute void and nba.early_exit_hazard are defined. Selection size and validation of the guard component are effect sizes from play-by-play.

player_assists#u4.rationale: The arena scorer-credit offset is a defined input. Its size and stability need more seasons with shrinkage, which is calibration.

player_availability#u2.rationale: The archetype is labelled game-level starter/active status, but its live contracts are season-level one-offs, and the game-level mechanism has no live series. That is an archetype-to-series mapping defect in the records.
player_availability#u2.catalog_action: Relabel player_availability as season-level availability/one-off status, move or drop the game-level 30-minute-confirmation stage, and update its series list after checking whether game-level markets list.

player_availability#u3.rationale: Starter retention, return-date slippage and status-to-play rates are priors of existing inputs. Official injury reports and box scores give them.

player_availability#u5.rationale: nba.unsigned_player_signing_hazard is defined with its covariates. The camp, injury-wave and buyout bumps are coefficients for a discrete-time hazard fit.

player_escalator_payout#u2.rationale: Beta-binomial dispersion is carried by an existing input (nba.within_game_make_dispersion). rho, and whether it beats a shot-quality-adjusted binomial, is estimation.

player_escalator_payout#u3.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.load_mgmt already exist in the NBA catalog (attached to game_total, combo_props, player_availability, season_futures_team); whether rest or standings shift heavy-minute probability beyond projected minutes is a regression test before attaching them.

player_escalator_payout#u5.rationale: All five priors (rho, heavy-minute share, attempt sd, minutes-attempts correlation, recency weight) are magnitudes of defined inputs. Player-game shot logs give them.

player_free_throws#u2.rationale: nba.injuries_pit and nba.teammate_absence_shift are attached. Whether absence works through usage or trip rate is an empirical channel test on free-throw volume.

player_free_throws#u4.rationale: The FT%-3P% prior is defined. The slope and the 80-attempt prior strength are coefficients to estimate on 10 seasons of shooters.

player_h2h_series_stats#u3.rationale: Pair-type correlations, tie masses and series-length means are magnitudes. Box scores and playoff results give them.

player_h2h_series_stats#u4.rationale: nba.player_shooting_regression is attached. How strongly it shrinks across series games and for low-attempt shooters is a shrinkage-constant calibration.

player_h2h_series_stats#u5.rationale: The 1/N tie rule is known and nba.streak_hit_persistence exists. Tie-at-top frequency and per-game hit correlation are frequencies from playoff game logs.

player_milestones#pm-situational-gap.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.load_mgmt already exist in the NBA catalog (attached to game_total, combo_props, player_availability, season_futures_team); the gap itself asks whether rest or clinch state adds anything beyond projected minutes, which a minutes-error backtest answers.

player_milestones#pm-stat-chase-size.rationale: A teammate-gifting multiplier near 10 is a hypothesized effect size. Pooled empirical-Bayes on play-by-play tests whether it differs from 1.

player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.rationale: Mapping action only: KXNBABENCHPTS must not sit in a single-player points archetype without evidence, and the catalog's bench model and ledger live in game_overtime_and_team_events; the entity (a team's bench total or a named player as a bench player) is UNRESOLVED: the only evidence is the title 'NBA Bench Points' and scope 'Bench Points', and BASKETBALLENTITYSTAT.pdf is also the terms file of player-prop series (live Kalshi series data checked 2026-11-09). That evidence limitation is classified separately as game_overtime_and_team_events#u8.
player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.catalog_action: Move KXNBABENCHPTS out of player_points to game_overtime_and_team_events (which owns nba.team_bench_points_model and nba.starter_bench_definition_ledger) and update both records and input lists consistently; the entity question stays open in u8.

player_points#pp-situational.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.load_mgmt already exist in the NBA catalog (attached to game_total, combo_props, player_availability, season_futures_team); rest-for-seeding effects outside the injury report are a minutes-error backtest by clinch status.

player_rebounds#pr-leakage-source.rationale: The creditable-pool definition exists. The team-rebound leakage share is a number to compute from box scores that report team rebounds separately.

player_rebounds#pr-situational.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.load_mgmt already exist in the NBA catalog (attached to game_total, combo_props, player_availability, season_futures_team); whether bigs' minutes need a separate rest or ramp term is a projected-minutes error backtest.

player_threes#p3-hothand.rationale: Within-game persistence is the hot-hand question, and its existence and size are an autocorrelation test on shot logs. nba.within_game_make_dispersion already exists in the catalog to carry it if real.

player_threes#p3-situational.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.load_mgmt already exist in the NBA catalog (attached to game_total, combo_props, player_availability, season_futures_team); rest and travel effects on 3P% are a residual backtest by schedule state.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-2h-ot-split.rationale: The texts are explicit: KXNBA2H, 2HSPREAD and 2HTOTAL include OT, and 2HWINNER excludes it. No input defines how one simulated game yields both the regulation-only and the OT-inclusive 2H margin, so that definition is missing.
quarter_and_half_markets#qh-2h-ot-split.catalog_action: In quarter_and_half_markets, define the OT-inclusive 2H margin as regulation 2H margin plus an OT increment from nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin, and map KXNBA2HWINNER and KXNBA2H to the two outputs.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-live-state.rationale: Checked live via the Kalshi API: KXNBA2H-26NOV07SASPOR markets have close_time 05:35Z, after the game ended, with early close 'after a winner is declared'. Later-period markets trade in play, so in-game state inputs are required and the record has none.
quarter_and_half_markets#qh-live-state.catalog_action: Author a live-state input set in quarter_and_half_markets (score at period start, clock, on-court lineups, team-foul/bonus state from cdn.nba.com liveData) and attach it to the Q2-Q4 and 2H series.

quarter_and_half_markets#qh-q3-effect.rationale: Coach Q3 effects are an existing mechanism term. Their variance component and out-of-sample persistence are estimated from quarter scores.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-coaching-ga.rationale: Opening scripts and first-substitution timing are measurable coach effects on first-stint scoring. Whether they persist is an estimation question on play-by-play.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-officiating.rationale: nba.referee_crew exists in the catalog. Whether crew early-foul rates predict first-to-N outcomes is a test to run before attaching it.

race_to_and_points_leader#rl-tie-rule.rationale: The 1/N tie rule is verified and nba.leader_share_by_usage_rank handles ties. The tied-maximum frequency is a box-score count.

season_futures_team#sf-cup-rule.rationale: Verified for 2026-27: all Cup games except the championship (Dec 11, Hinkle Fieldhouse) count toward the regular season. The existing schedule stage already versions filler games. Their opponents and dates are announced after group play and must be captured when published.

season_futures_team#sf-mixed-bucket.rationale: The catalog's MVP voter-score model already uses team win% as a covariate (awards_draft). Fitting the conditional logit coefficient on 20 seasons of voting is calibration.

season_futures_team#sf-tiebreak-and-divi.rationale: The tiebreak order is a published rule that does not change inputs. The record does carry two inputs for one mechanism, nba.division_race_tiebreak_state and nba.tiebreak_ledger, with no duplicate marking, which is a demonstrable catalog defect.
season_futures_team#sf-tiebreak-and-divi.catalog_action: Mark nba.division_race_tiebreak_state DUPLICATE_OF nba.tiebreak_ledger in the NBA catalog, and code the 2026-27 league tiebreak procedure into nba.tiebreak_ledger for season_futures_team.

season_stat_markets#ss-coaching-gap.rationale: Coaching changes shift role and minutes through existing usage and minutes inputs. Their size on stat races is a backtest of usage after coaching changes.

season_stat_markets#ss-low-volume-three-.rationale: nba.three_volume is defined. Extending its prior to near-zero-attempt players (a zero-inflated hierarchical form) is model calibration on low-volume bigs.

season_stat_markets#ss-ownership-overlap.rationale: Streak contracts and win totals sit in two archetypes that need the same season path simulation. nba.team_win_streak_hazard and nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model overlap, and no shared simulation is defined.
season_stat_markets#ss-ownership-overlap.catalog_action: Define one shared regular-season path simulation input referenced by season_futures_team and season_stat_markets, and record nba.team_win_streak_hazard and nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model as views of it.

season_stat_markets#ss-rules-versioning.rationale: The rounding and late-correction policy applied to averages at settlement is a contract and Source-Agency matter that only Kalshi can confirm. Arena steal/block credit effects are already an empirical item (sbt-credit-bias-size).

series_and_cup#sc-archetype-mismatch.rationale: Cup group/knockout contracts and the comeback/blowout series contracts sit in a best-of-seven archetype with different mechanisms and data. The records have not decided whether to split or keep a separate stage: an open archetype mapping defect.
series_and_cup#sc-archetype-mismatch.catalog_action: Decide and record in series_and_cup whether Cup contracts move to their own archetype (with nba.cup_format, nba.cup_group_tiebreak_state) and file the comeback/blowout series with in-game score inputs.

series_and_cup#sc-coaching-gap.rationale: nba.playoff_rotation and nba.cup_group_tiebreak_state exist. Coach rotation shortening, in-series adjustment and Cup margin-chasing are effect sizes to estimate from play-by-play.

series_and_cup#sc-cup-bracket-structure.rationale: Verified for 2026-27: three group winners plus one wild card per conference make conference-split quarterfinals. Semifinals are now at the higher seed's arena and only the final is neutral, at Hinkle Fieldhouse, Indianapolis. The record wrongly gives the semifinal zero home advantage and models a shared semifinal site.
series_and_cup#sc-cup-bracket-structure.catalog_action: In series_and_cup, update nba.cup_finals_pair_probability and nba.cup_format: home-court for the higher seed in the semifinal, no shared-venue copula, neutral final at Hinkle Fieldhouse, and wild card = best second-place team per conference.

series_and_cup#sc-ownership-overlap.rationale: Series lengths and advancement are consumed by season_futures_team, player_milestones and the playoff-points record, but no single shared bracket simulation input is defined. Each consumer references pieces, which leaves the catalog structurally incomplete.
series_and_cup#sc-ownership-overlap.catalog_action: Author one shared nba.playoff_bracket_simulation input (play-in to Finals, series lengths, advancement) and make season_futures_team, player_milestones, series_and_cup and the playoff-points record reference it.

steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-credit-bias-.rationale: Arena scorer bias and the dispersion index are magnitudes of existing terms. Arena fixed effects over five seasons settle them.

steals_blocks_turnovers#sbt-situational.rationale: nba.rest_travel and nba.load_mgmt already exist in the NBA catalog (attached to game_total, combo_props, player_availability, season_futures_team); whether fatigue shifts per-minute activity events is a rest-state backtest of deflections and steals per 36.

summer_league_games#sl-efficiency-gap.rationale: nba.player_shooting_regression exists. Shrinking a rookie toward a college/G League-translated prior is a translation and shrinkage fit on historical rookies.

summer_league_games#sl-event-effects.rationale: nba.venue is in the catalog. Las Vegas vs Salt Lake event effects on pace and scoring are fixed effects from past results.

summer_league_games#sl-format-facts.rationale: Verified for 2026 (nba.com format and press): four 10-minute quarters, foul-out at 10 (6 in semifinal/final), 2-minute OT then sudden death, a one-free-throw rule before the last two minutes. These scale existing inputs. Their effect on totals is a magnitude.

team_total#tt-environment-gap.rationale: nba.venue exists in the catalog. Arena effects on points per possession are fixed effects from box scores, to test before attaching.

team_total#tt-schedule-gap.rationale: nba.rest_travel is in the catalog and attached to game_total, which team_total derives from. Rest effects on efficiency and pace are a residual backtest.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u7.rationale: Doubling-up fatigue, home-market entrants and crowd influence on judges are effects to test against contest score residuals. No new information category is needed.

unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u8.rationale: Seven disjoint processes share one record with per-series input scoping, and no blueprint fits. Whether to split into contests, exhibitions and MVP archetypes is an unresolved archetype mapping defect.
unreg:all_star_weekend_events#u8.catalog_action: Split all_star_weekend_events into skills contests, team exhibitions and MVP archetypes (or author an exhibition blueprint) and reassign each series' inputs.

unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials#.rationale: The archetype is labelled counting specials but its only live series is playoff single-game points, and its catalog input list is stale. That is an archetype/series mapping defect.
unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials#.catalog_action: Relabel the archetype as playoff single-game player thresholds (or merge with KXNBAPLAYOFF3D in player_milestones) and replace its catalog input list with the staged inputs.

unreg:team_and_player_counting_specials#.rationale: Opponent doubling and coach willingness to play 45+ minutes act through points-per-minute and minutes inputs already used. Their effect on the 50-point tail is an estimate from playoff play-by-play.
